title: BulkTagAssetsRequest
description: Request body for bulk adding/removing tags across multiple assets. Keyed by asset identifier.

asset_tags.title: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Add/Remove options keyed on the asset you would like to be updated

add_tags.title: Add Tags
add_tags.description: List of tag names to apply to the assets

remove_tags.title: Remove Tags
remove_tags.description: List of tag names to remove from the assets

TagAssetRequest.title: TagAssetRequest
TagAssetRequest.description: Add and/or remove tag operations for a single asset.
